problems.problem: Two competing ring systems coexist: the printed pale-grey ripple rings generated around the canvas middle (visible arcs from ~(100,240) to ~(1130,1170)) and the deterministic filled ellipses anchored top-left at (540,806), whose centers land at ~(1004,1270), i.e. the bottom-right corner. The pink #D6231F@0.12 disc and the two grey discs therefore read as an off-concept corner blob, not as part of the concentric ripple field.
problems.root_cause: background.shapes ellipse x/y were set as if they were centers while the renderer treats them as upper-left, displacing all three discs ~460px down-right of the bottle base.
problems.repair_strategy: Re-center all three ellipses on the product base (540,1131) with a complete replacement list so the printed rings and the tonal discs share one convergence point.

problems.problem: The brief reserves the only saturated red for the observed cap and label band, but the 12% red ellipse renders as a large desaturated pink disc (~430px wide) touching the bottle's right flank at (700-970, 810-1240). It dilutes the single-red proposition and sits behind the base exactly where the contact shadow reads, muddying the grounding cue in the contact crop.
problems.root_cause: Red ellipse placed off-center with too large a footprint and too high an opacity for an accent-only role.
problems.repair_strategy: Shrink the red ellipse to a small halo concentric with the base and drop opacity to ~0.08, or recolor it to the grey ink family.

problems.problem: Product height ratio is 0.4514 (valid per fresh_concept_size_policy 0.35-0.74, so no size violation), yet against the 1080x1440 canvas the bottle reads as a small isolated object inside a large empty field; the references achieve dominance through scale or full-bleed geometry. The ripple rings stop short of the frame edges on the left, so the 'gravity' event feels tentative rather than commanding.
problems.root_cause: Scale chosen at the low-middle of the allowed band while the surrounding geometry does not compensate with edge-to-edge reach.
problems.repair_strategy: Artistic resize within policy: raise product height to ~0.55 of canvas (height 792, y 735) keeping base at 1131 and center x 540, so the red band anchors the rings visibly.

problems.problem: The outer grey ellipse edge cuts a visible diagonal tonal seam through the bottom-right quadrant, passing within ~60px above the subtitle bbox (648,1354)-(962,1380). The subtitle therefore sits on a split field, weakening the corner colophon alignment with the logo at bottom-left.
problems.root_cause: Off-center ellipse boundaries intersecting the lower copy zone.
problems.repair_strategy: After re-centering the ellipse stack on the base, the seam moves out of the subtitle zone; additionally nudge subtitle y to 1372 for a cleaner baseline pairing with the logo line.
